{{Infobox Slayer |name = Venators |icon = [[File:Venator slayer_icon.png|center]] |skillreq = {{SCP|Slayer|74}} |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|100}} |otherreq = Completion of [[The Blood Moon Rises]] |mazchna = 10-20 (200-250) |vannaka = 10-20 (200-250) |chaeldar = 80-100 (200-250) |konar = 100-160 (200-250) |nieve = 110-170 (200-250) |duradel = 100-210 (200-250) |mortimer = 120-180 (170-280) |id = 33826 }} [[Venators]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]], exclusively by [[Mortimer]] once the player has completed [[The Blood Moon Rises]]. Alternatively, after spending 80 Slayer points and unlocking the [[Actual Vampyre Slayer]] perk, they can be killed while on a [[Slayer task/Vampyres|Vampyre]] task assigned by [[Konar quo Maten|Konar]], [[Duradel]], [[Nieve]], and [[Chaeldar]]. [[Mazchna]] and [[Vannaka]] can also assign Vampyres as a Slayer task by default, though in much lower quantities. Venators can only be found in [[Vampyrium]], in the designated hunting grounds to the south of the entrance portal. Venators are classified as tier 3 [[Vampyre (attribute)|Vampyres]], meaning they require the [[Ivandis flail]] as a minimum in order to damage them. Other superior weapons, such as blisterwood, the [[hallowed flail]] and [[sunspear]] will also work. [[Efaritay's aid]] is highly recommended for slaying venators, as it provides additional accuracy and damage that stacks on top of the slayer helm, meaning that attacks are much more accurate and stronger compared to using standard rings such as the [[Treasonous ring|treasonous]] or [[ultor ring]]s. Each Efaritay's aid costs {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Efaritay's aid}}}} and comes with 200 charges, meaning that each charge costs {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Efaritay's aid|0.005}}}} coins, which is well worth the cost for most players. ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer reward point}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-left-2 align-left-4" style="text-align:center;" !class="unsortable"| !Unlock !Points cost !Notes |- |[[File:Vampyre icon.png|link=]] |Actual Vampyre Slayer |80 |Konar, Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar will be able to assign [[Vampyre]]s as your task. |- |[[File:Vampyre icon.png|link=]] |More at stake |100 |Number of [[Vampyre]]s assigned is increased to 200-250. |} ==Monster Variants== {|class = "wikitable sortable" !Monster !Combat level !Slayer XP !Locations !Notes |- |[[Venator]] |246 |405 | * [[Apsul Hunting Ground]] * [[Virer Hunting Ground]] | * Found in [[Vampyrium]], which is accessed in the quest [[The Blood Moon Rises]]. * Has a superior variant, the [[blood-starved venator]], with a hugely increased chance for a [[blood shard]] * Can only be damaged by one of the following: [[Blisterwood stake]]s, the [[Sunspear]], the [[Ivandis flail]], the [[blisterwood flail]], or the [[hallowed flail]]. |} ==Location Comparison== {|class = "wikitable sortable align-center-3" !Location !Maplink !Amount !Multicombat !Cannonable !Safespottable !Notes |- |[[Apsul Hunting Ground]] |{{Map|type=maplink |name = Venator |location = [[Apsul Hunting Ground]] |ptype = monster |levels = 246 |mapID = -1 |x:2570,y:7749|x:2577,y:7747|x:2582,y:7750|x:2583,y:7760|x:2590,y:7763|x:2591,y:7755|x:2599,y:7765 |mtype = pin }} | 7 Venators
